text: 央行节前放大招！隔夜逆回购上限飙至1万亿，MLF净投放2000亿，什么信号？ 隔夜逆回购每日操作上限从此前三轮的6000亿元提升至10000亿元，是本次操作最值得关注的变化。
text_en: PBOC makes a big move before the holiday! Overnight reverse repo cap surges to 1 trillion yuan, MLF net injection of 200 billion yuan — what signal does this send? The daily operational cap for overnight reverse repos was raised to 1 trillion yuan from 600 billion yuan in the previous three rounds, the most noteworthy change in this operation.
